profile.name: Eman Ramadan
profile.title: Full Stack Developer
profile.tagline: I build scalable web apps — clean architecture, real-world impact.
profile.bio: I am a Full Stack .NET Developer skilled in C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, SQL Server, and Angular, with experience in real-time communication using SignalR and database management. I specialize in building scalable web applications, implementing validation and auditing mechanisms, and applying design patterns for clean architecture. Passionate about problem-solving and continuous learning, I thrive in collaborative environments.

about.summary: Full Stack .NET Developer with a hands-on experience building production web applications. I care deeply about clean architecture, maintainable code, and shipping things that actually work.

experience.title: Junior Software Developer
bullets: Engineered a full-stack Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance system from the ground up, enabling real-time monitoring and detection of suspicious financial transactions using ASP.NET Core, Angular, and Python API integration.
Implemented real-time event broadcasting via SignalR & WebSockets, supporting both individual and bulk transaction workflows with advanced search and filtering capabilities.
Designed asynchronous background job processing pipelines that improved system throughput, reduced server load, and enhanced scalability under concurrent request loads.
Extended and customized the AXISS insurance core system using JavaScript and YAML configuration, successfully implementing complex business rules without source code access.
